## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4005. The issue was that **storefront-web 3.0 includes new OpenTelemetry instrumentation that is unable to connect to the otel-collector service**, causing request processing to block or fail. While the pods pass health checks (returning 200 on /healthz), the actual request path hangs due to telemetry export queue saturation, resulting in the 502 Bad Gateway error from ingress-nginx.

The ticket owner now has three actionable solutions:
1. Verify the OpenTelemetry collector is running in the observability namespace
2. Configure the application to handle telemetry failures gracefully
3. Temporarily disable OpenTelemetry exports until infrastructure is ready

This allows them to resolve the issue without rolling back the pricing fix in version 3.0.
